title: 怎样向不同时区的同事发清楚会议邀请
topic: 全远程团队怎样安排和参加会议

source.title: All-Remote Meetings | The GitLab Handbook
source.section: What to do before the meeting — all nine guidelines
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 本课聚焦必要会议的邀请信息：写明不同地区的当地时间，提前 72 小时发出（至少提前 24 小时），并把非必要参与者标成可选。来源也建议先判断是否可异步完成；季度评审情境为虚构示例。
paragraphs: We’re thoughtful about how we run meetings, because, when done right, they are forums to increase efficiency, enhance collaboration, and drive results. The guidelines below are intended to help you run a great meeting at GitLab!

Ask yourself if the meeting is necessary. Though we have a bias toward asynchronous communication, a strategic balance between synchronous and asynchronous communication is required to achieve maximum efficiency. Moving a project or discussion forward asynchronously when feasible is preferred if it can be done efficiently and achieve desired results. Before scheduling a meeting, ask yourself if asynchronous methods could be effectively used to achieve the desired outcome.

Review participants time zones. Though we have a bias toward asynchronous communication, when a meeting is determined to be necessary review all participants’ time zones. Consider creating meetings that overlap between EMEA/APAC + APAC/AMER + AMER/EMEA.
Ensure meeting DRI. When creating meeting across time zones, nominate volunteers to host and facilitate those meetings in their working hours that align better with their time zones.

Send the meeting invite with proper advance notice. A meeting with team members will usually traverse multiple time zones. We recommend you send meeting invites 72 hours (minimum 24 hours) in advance of the meeting to give people time to respond to the invite. In addition, consider who is required in the meeting and mark non-essential participants as optional.
translations: 我们认真思考如何运行会议，因为当会议正确进行时，它们是提高效率、增强协作和推动成果的论坛。以下指南旨在帮助您在 GitLab 举办一场成功的会议！
问问自己会议是否必要。尽管我们倾向于异步沟通，但为了实现最大效率，同步与异步沟通之间需要战略平衡。如果能够高效进行并取得预期成果，优先选择通过异步方式推进项目或讨论。在安排会议前，问问自己是否可以使用异步方法有效实现预期结果。
审查参与者的时区。尽管我们倾向于异步沟通，但当确定会议必要时，请审查所有参与者的时区。考虑创建在 EMEA/APAC + APAC/AMER + AMER/EMEA 之间有重叠的会议。
确保会议有指定负责人。在跨时区创建会议时，指派志愿者在他们的工作时间（更好地符合他们的时区）内主持和促进这些会议。
提前适当发送会议邀请。团队成员参与的会议通常会跨越多个时区。我们建议您在会议前 72 小时（至少 24 小时）发送会议邀请，以便人们有时间回复邀请。此外，考虑会议中哪些人是必需的，并将非必要参与者标记为可选。
fullTextParagraphs: We’re thoughtful about how we run meetings, because, when done right, they are forums to increase efficiency, enhance collaboration, and drive results. The guidelines below are intended to help you run a great meeting at GitLab!

Ask yourself if the meeting is necessary. Though we have a bias toward asynchronous communication, a strategic balance between synchronous and asynchronous communication is required to achieve maximum efficiency. Moving a project or discussion forward asynchronously when feasible is preferred if it can be done efficiently and achieve desired results. Before scheduling a meeting, ask yourself if asynchronous methods could be effectively used to achieve the desired outcome.

Review participants time zones. Though we have a bias toward asynchronous communication, when a meeting is determined to be necessary review all participants’ time zones. Consider creating meetings that overlap between EMEA/APAC + APAC/AMER + AMER/EMEA.
Ensure meeting DRI. When creating meeting across time zones, nominate volunteers to host and facilitate those meetings in their working hours that align better with their time zones.

Send the meeting invite with proper advance notice. A meeting with team members will usually traverse multiple time zones. We recommend you send meeting invites 72 hours (minimum 24 hours) in advance of the meeting to give people time to respond to the invite. In addition, consider who is required in the meeting and mark non-essential participants as optional.

Include a link to an agenda document in the invite. Team members should be able to get context before the meeting through reviewing agendas, supporting materials, etc. Meeting agendas should be shared 72 hours (minimum 24 hours) in advance of the meeting. Team members will need to know what is being discussed to decide if their participation is needed or whether their meeting attendance is optional.

Provide slides and supporting videos in advance. We embrace Neurodiversity by adopting a variety of different work styles and communication styles. Providing multiple ways to consume information (written / video / audio) allows everyone to contribute independent of their preferred comprehension style.
Use “speedy meetings.” This Google Calendar setting creates meetings of 25 / 50 minute duration, which leaves time to write notes, stretch, etc. in between meetings.

Use the Zoom scheduler plug-in to add video conferencing to your Google Calendar event. Leveraging the Zoom plug-in automatically adds Zoom links to your event, and reduces the probability of user error in copying and pasting an incorrect video conferencing link.

Check your audio quality. Research shows that when the audio quality is high, people judge the content as better and more important. We recommend you invest in equipment to generate the highest-fidelity audio in your remote work setting, such as using a microphone.

notes.phrase: Before scheduling a meeting, ask yourself if asynchronous methods could be effectively used to achieve the desired outcome.
notes.meaning: 安排会议前，先判断是否能用异步方式有效达成目标。
notes.explain: 来源偏好异步沟通，但仍可在异步方式无法有效推进时安排必要会议。
notes.example: Could we resolve this in the project document before scheduling a call?

notes.explain: 跨区会议应写明对每位参与者适用的当地时间，并考虑工作时间重叠。
notes.example: I’ve listed both Seattle and London time in the invite.

notes.phrase: We recommend you send meeting invites 72 hours (minimum 24 hours) in advance of the meeting to give people time to respond to the invite.
notes.meaning: 建议至少提前 24 小时发送会议邀请，最好提前 72 小时，让大家有时间回复。
notes.explain: 来源建议提前 72 小时，最低提前 24 小时；两者分别是建议值与最低提前量。
notes.example: I’ll send the invite three days ahead so everyone has time to respond.

notes.meaning: 把非必要参会者标记为可选。
notes.explain: 只有需要直接参与讨论的人应列为必要；其他人可以自行决定是否参加。
notes.example: I’ve marked the wider project group as optional.

scenario.title: Sending a clear invitation for a necessary global meeting
english: An asynchronous review has not resolved an issue, so a product review with teammates in Seattle and London is necessary.
The meeting is scheduled for January 13, 2027. Required participants need the local time for each city; other colleagues only need to stay informed.
You write the time in both zones, send the invite 72 hours in advance, and mark nonessential participants as optional.
chinese: 异步评审还没有解决一个问题，因此需要让西雅图和伦敦的同事开一次产品评审会。
会议定在 2027 年 1 月 13 日。必要参会者需要看到两地当地时间；其他同事只需了解进展。
你在邀请中写清两个时区的时间，提前 72 小时发出邀请，并把非必要参会者标为可选。

firstAttempt.prompt: 异步评审没能解决问题，你需要安排一场 2027 年 1 月 13 日的产品评审，伦敦和西雅图同事都会参加。请用英文写明两地当地时间、说明会提前 72 小时发送邀请，并把非必要参会者标为可选。
firstAttempt.sample: The product review is Wednesday, January 13, 2027, at 9 a.m. PST / 5 p.m. GMT. I’ll send the invite 72 hours in advance so everyone has time to respond. I’ve marked nonessential participants as optional.
firstAttempt.rationale: 必要会议应先核对当地时区、给参与者足够时间回复，并让不必参加的人可以选择是否加入。

words.example: Could we resolve this asynchronously before scheduling a call?
words.translation: 安排通话前，我们能否先用异步方式解决这个问题？
words.note: 沟通不要求所有人同时在线。

words.example: Please check the participants’ time zones before sending the invite.
words.translation: 发出邀请前，请核对参与者的时区。
words.note: 各地标准时间不同，跨时区邀请应注明城市或时区缩写。

words.example: The team needs advance notice to respond to the meeting invite.
words.translation: 团队需要提前收到通知，才能回复会议邀请。
words.note: 提前给通知对象留出安排时间。

words.example: Mark colleagues who do not need to contribute as optional.
words.translation: 把不需要直接参与的同事标为可选。
words.note: 表示可以选择是否参加，不是必须。

words.example: Invite the required participants and mark others as optional.
words.translation: 邀请必要参会者，并将其他人标为可选。
words.note: 标记需要直接参与本次讨论的人。

words.example: Look for a time-zone overlap that falls within participants’ working hours.
words.translation: 寻找落在参与者工作时间内的时区重叠时段。
words.note: 不同地区工作时间重合的部分。

structure.original: We recommend you send meeting invites 72 hours (minimum 24 hours) in advance of the meeting to give people time to respond to the invite.
analysis: 主句 We recommend 后接省略 that 的宾语从句 you send meeting invites。
72 hours (minimum 24 hours) in advance 表示建议的提前时间和最低提前时间。
to give people time to respond to the invite 表示提前发送邀请的目的。
structure.transfer: State the local times, send the invitation with enough notice, and mark people who are not essential as optional.

rewrite.bad: Let’s schedule the meeting at the only time that works for me and invite everyone as required.
rewrite.good: The product review is Wednesday, January 13, 2027, at 9 a.m. PST / 5 p.m. GMT. I’ll send the invite 72 hours in advance so everyone has time to respond. I’ve marked nonessential participants as optional.
rewrite.translation: 产品评审会定在 2027 年 1 月 13 日西雅图上午 9 点（PST）／伦敦下午 5 点（GMT）。我会提前 72 小时发送邀请，让大家有时间回复。我已将非必要参会者标为可选。
rewrite.pattern: The meeting is at [local time A] / [local time B]. I’ll send the invite [advance notice]. I’ve marked [nonessential participants] as optional.

cloze.prompt: The review is at 9 a.m. PST / 5 p.m. ___ .
cloze.why: GMT 标明伦敦当地时区，避免只给西雅图时间。

cloze.prompt: I’ll send the invite 72 hours in ___ .
cloze.why: in advance 表示提前；手册建议 72 小时，最低 24 小时。
optional 表示可以参加，但不属于必要参会者。

dictation.text: We recommend you send meeting invites 72 hours (minimum 24 hours) in advance of the meeting to give people time to respond to the invite.
dictation.label: 听写 1 · 提前发送会议邀请
dictation.why: 听辨 72 hours 和 minimum 24 hours 的建议与最低提前量。

dictation.text: In addition, consider who is required in the meeting and mark non-essential participants as optional.
dictation.label: 听写 2 · 区分必要与可选参会者
dictation.why: 听出 required 和 non-essential / optional 的区别。

apply.prompt: 为跨时区评审写一句话，说明已将不必直接参会的同事标为可选。
apply.sample: I’ve marked nonessential participants as optional.

translationPractice.prompt: 产品评审会定在 2027 年 1 月 13 日西雅图上午 9 点（PST）／伦敦下午 5 点（GMT）。
translationPractice.answer: The product review is Wednesday, January 13, 2027, at 9 a.m. PST / 5 p.m. GMT.
translationPractice.why: 列出日期、城市对应时区缩写和当地时间，避免只写一个时区。

translationPractice.prompt: 我会提前 72 小时发送邀请，让大家有时间回复。
translationPractice.answer: I’ll send the invite 72 hours in advance so everyone has time to respond.
translationPractice.why: 72 hours in advance 表示提前 72 小时；so 引出提前发送邀请的目的。

translationPractice.prompt: 我已将非必要参会者标为可选。
translationPractice.answer: I’ve marked nonessential participants as optional.
translationPractice.why: mark A as optional 表示将 A 标记为可选参与者。

choice.prompt: 异步评审没能解决问题，你需要安排一场 2027 年 1 月 13 日的产品评审，伦敦和西雅图同事都会参加。请用英文写明两地当地时间、说明会提前 72 小时发送邀请，并把非必要参会者标为可选。
options: The meeting is sometime Wednesday. I’ll invite everyone as required and share notes if I remember.

The product review is Wednesday, January 13, 2027, at 9 a.m. PST / 5 p.m. GMT. I’ll send the invite 72 hours in advance so everyone has time to respond. I’ve marked nonessential participants as optional.
The review is at 9 a.m. Seattle time. I’m sending the invite now for tomorrow, and all project members must attend.
choice.why: 正确项写明同一天两地时间、提前 72 小时发邀请并标记可选参会者；其他选项时间不完整或通知过晚。

output.prompt: 异步材料评审还没能解决供应商选型问题，你要安排 2027 年 4 月 6 日的供应商评审，让西雅图和伦敦的同事参加。请写明两地当地时间、提前 72 小时发送邀请，并将非必要参会者标为可选。
output.sample: The vendor review is Tuesday, April 6, 2027, at 10 a.m. PDT / 6 p.m. BST. I’ll send the invite 72 hours in advance so everyone has time to respond. I’ve marked nonessential participants as optional.
check: 是否写明同一天的 PST/PDT/GMT/BST 当地时区时间？
是否说明会提前 72 小时发邀请？
是否把非必要参会者标为可选？
